title: Hypergraph-based Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Incremental Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2608.16628v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (M-RAG) systems are fundamentally limited by the binary connectivity paradigm of traditional simple graphs, which fails to capture the intricate, high-order correlations among heterogeneous entities, such as the N-ary relationships between a visual chart, its scattered textual descriptions, and underlying numerical data. Furthermore, existing refinement strategies often rely on exhaustive, full-page reconstruction to align cross-modal information, leading to prohibitive computational redundancy and the introduction of contextual noise in long-form document processing. In this paper, we propose Hyper-M2RAG, a novel framework that redefines multimodal document retrieval through High-order Hypergraph Representation Learning. translated_title: 基于超图的多模态检索增强生成与增量细化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16628v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现代多模态检索增强生成（M-RAG）系统从根本上受限于传统简单图的二元连接范式，该范式无法捕捉异构实体之间复杂的高阶关联，例如视觉图表、其分散的文本描述和底层数值数据之间的N元关系。此外，现有的细化策略通常依赖于穷举式的整页重构来对齐跨模态信息，导致在长文档处理中产生过高的计算冗余并引入上下文噪声。在本文中，我们提出Hyper-M2RAG，一种通过高阶超图表示学习重新定义多模态文档检索的新型框架。我们首先将文档结构形式化为多模态超图，利用超边作为统一语义容器来封装跨文本的多元关联。
tldr: 本文提出Hyper-M2RAG框架，利用高阶超图表示学习捕捉多模态文档中的复杂N元关联，并采用增量细化策略避免整页重构，从而提高检索效率并减少噪声。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Hyper-M2RAG, a framework that leverages high-order hypergraph representation learning to capture complex N-ary associations in multimodal documents, employing incremental refinement to avoid full-page reconstruction, thereby improving retrieval efficiency and reducing noise.
